description: Updates an existing status page. config holds only the settings to change; the rest keep their stored values. publicGroupList, when passed, replaces all of the page's groups: a group left out is deleted, and a group is kept rather than recreated only if you include its id. Omit it to leave the groups as they are. Read the current state with getStatusPage first.

config.description: The settings to change, merged onto the stored page: title, description, theme, published, showTags, showPoweredBy, domainNameList, customCSS, footerText, icon, etc. Omit to change only the groups.

imgDataUrl.description: Icon as data URL. Omit or pass empty string to keep existing.

publicGroupList.description: Ordered groups, replacing all current ones. Each: {id?, name, monitorList: [{id}]}. Omit to keep the current groups.

name: updateStatusPage
title: Update Status Page
